text: what does the aint colony do when they find a major resource? they just send 1 ant right? done and dusted?
lesson: When a major resource or breakthrough is found, do NOT treat it as a single incremental step. The ant colony response is: reinforce trail immediately + swarm. That means: (1) capture the breakthrough phetrail verbatim, (2) immediately apply it to ALL similar problem classes, (3) stop asking permission to execute what is already proven, (4) stop presenting it as a 1-step increment. Sending 1 ant when you found a feast is how colonies starve.
